# PowerShell RulesnnThese rules apply to `*.ps1`, `*.psm1`, and `*.psd1` in this repository.nn## Build and Testnn- Run setup before development tasks: `./Tools/setup.ps1`.n- Unit tests run against the built module in `Release/`.n- Run `Invoke-Build -Task Build, Test` before commit.n- Run `Invoke-Build -Task TestIntegration` for integration changes.nn## Cloud and Data Centernn- Keep request/response behavior compatible across Confluence Cloud and Data Center.n- Do not ship API changes that only work on one deployment target without explicit handling.n- Use integration test tags and workflows to validate both tracks.nn## CInn- Keep `CI Result` as the required branch-protection check.n- Do not bypass linting, build, unit matrix, or smoke integration checks.n
